sections.Profile:
"Super Hockey" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on April 15, 1949. The game features two reverse flippers, two pop bumpers, six passive bumpers, two slingshots, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Hockey, Sports, Original Theme, Winter
